summary: Camarines Norte 2nd District representative with 24 principal-authored bills. Authored institutionalized assistance to individuals in crisis, Ayuda sa Kapos ang Kita income support, retroactive pay increases for civil personnel, a higher nurses' entry-level grade and elderly welfare protections. Co-authored the national minimum wage, online-platform work regulation, no-work-no-pay for lawmakers and anti-dynasty bills.
caveat: Democratic score rests on co-authored bills only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored crisis assistance and Ayuda sa Kapos ang Kita income support (-3), retroactive pay increases and higher nurses' entry grade (-2); co-authored the national minimum wage and online-platform work regulation (-2).
